children: Gold holds steady in Asian trade. Selling pressure on the yellow metal has eased, but buying interest remains insufficient to establish a new direction, XS.com's Linh Tran says in a note. "The market is finding a balance between demand for gold accumulation and pressure from high interest rates," the market analyst adds. A higher interest-rate environment typically weighs on nonyielding assets like gold. She expects continued consolidation in gold prices in the near term, with the Fed's October meeting and a U.S. inflation report likely to test this view. Spot gold is flat at $4,025.56 an ounce.(megan.cheah@wsj.com)
